integrity: The proof is an explicit Leibniz-rule derivation from the published definition. A numerical finite-difference checker is supplementary and is not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The corrected endpoint identities invalidate the cited derivative step, but this work does not assert that every downstream theorem has a false conclusion. Endpoint cases outside the stated positivity and regularity assumptions are not covered.
title: Correct endpoint derivatives for weighted interval Pearson divergence
